instruction.text: Select the external factors that can pollinate a plant.

atoms.b: Bees are responsible for the pollination of a ((++large small)) percentage of plants.
((++Other No_other)) insects, such as butterflies and beetles, also contribute to the pollination process.
Insects pollinate plants by landing on a flower, becoming covered in ((++pollen dirt)) and then carrying the pollen to a ((++new dead)) plant.
Larger animals, such as foxes, can also pollinate plants. When an animal brushes against a flower, pollen will attach to the ((++fur nose)) of the animal.
